arXiv:2606.02578v1 [cs.CV] 2026 年 6 月 1 日arXiv:2606.02578v1 [cs.CV] 01 Jun 2026

减轻多模式法学硕士法官的感知判断偏差Mitigating Perceptual Judgment Bias in Multimodal LLM-as-a-Judge
通过感知扰动和奖励建模via Perceptual Perturbation and Reward Modeling

Seojeong Park    Jiho Choi    Junyong Kang    Seonho Lee    Jaeyo Shin    Hyunjung Shim
摘要Abstract

最近的多模态大语言模型已经表现出强大的推理能力，但它们作为自动评估器的可靠性仍然受到一个严重弱点的限制：当视觉证据与文本线索发生冲突时，MLLM 法官倾向于奖励合理的叙述，而不是感知上正确的答案。 我们识别并系统地分析了这种现象，我们称之为Recent multimodal large language models have demonstrated strong reasoning ability, yet their reliability as automated evaluators remains limited by a critical weakness: when visual evidence conflicts with textual cues, MLLM judges tend to reward plausible narratives over perceptually correct answers. We identify and systematically analyze this phenomenon, which we term知觉判断偏差Perceptual Judgment Bias。 通过受控的视觉扰动，现有的多模式法官经常锚定响应文本而不是他们自己的视觉感知，从而导致不一致和不可验证的评估。 为了解决这个问题，我们引入. Through controlled visual perturbations, existing multimodal judges frequently anchor on the response text instead of their own visual perception, leading to inconsistent and non-verifiable evaluations. To address this issue, we introduce the感知干扰判断数据集Perceptually Perturbed Judgment Dataset，它构建最少编辑的反事实响应，隔离感知错误并实现可验证的监督。 在此数据集的基础上，我们开发了一个统一的训练框架，可以使用 GRPO 优化可验证的批量排名奖励，从而在没有明确的成对标签的情况下实现连贯的全局排序。 跨不同 MLLM-as-a-Judge 基准的实验表明，我们的方法大大提高了感知保真度、排名一致性以及与人类评估的一致性。 我们的方法建立了一个有原则的、可扩展的范式，用于培训多模式法官，这些法官具有感知基础、可解释且对视觉推理冲突具有鲁棒性。 项目页面：, which constructs minimally edited counterfactual responses that isolate perceptual errors and enable verifiable supervision. Building on this dataset, we develop a unified training framework that optimizes a verifiable batch-ranking reward with GRPO, achieving coherent global ordering without explicit pairwise labels. Experiments across diverse MLLM-as-a-Judge benchmarks show that our approach substantially improves perceptual fidelity, ranking coherence, and alignment with human evaluation. Our method establishes a principled and scalable paradigm for training multimodal judges that are perceptually grounded, interpretable, and robust to visual–reasoning conflicts. Project Page:https://perception-judge.github.io/

机器学习、ICMLMachine Learning, ICML

1 简介Introduction

多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 正在迅速重塑视觉景观——语言推理、基础和理解Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are rapidly reshaping the landscape of vision–language reasoning, grounding, and understanding(Achiam et al., 2023; Hurst et al., 2024; Liu et al., 2023; Bai et al., 2023; Yang et al., 2025; Wang et al., 2025a)。 他们整合文本和视觉信息的能力不断增强，在指令遵循和开放式多模式生成方面取得了令人瞩目的进步。 然而，评估多模式响应的质量仍然是一个根本挑战. Their growing ability to integrate textual and visual information has led to impressive progress in instruction following and open-ended multimodal generation. Nevertheless, evaluating the quality of multimodal responses remains a fundamental challenge(Li et al., 2024; Chiang et al., 2024; Li et al., 2025a; Zhang et al., 2025)。 随着 MLLM 越来越多地用于决策关键型应用. As MLLMs are increasingly used in decision-critical applications(Wang et al., 2025c; Li et al., 2024; Pu et al., 2025; Li et al., 2023)随着模型规模和基准范围的扩大，可靠的评估不仅对于模型之间的公平比较至关重要，而且对于可扩展地替代昂贵的人工评估也至关重要。 除了被动评估之外，强大的评估框架还可以通过生成指导 MLLM 调整和优化的奖励信号来积极促进迭代模型的改进, reliable evaluation becomes essential not only for fair comparison among models but also for scalable replacement of costly human evaluation as model sizes and benchmark scope expand. Beyond passive assessments, a strong evaluation framework can actively contribute to iterative model improvement by generating reward signals that guide MLLM alignment and optimization(Yuan et al., 2024; Li et al., 2025b; Ouyang et al., 2022; Zheng et al., 2023; Sun et al., 2023).

传统上，此类评估的黄金标准是人类判断The gold standard for such evaluation has traditionally been human judgment(Ouyang et al., 2022; Dai et al., 2023; Yuan et al., 2023);然而，这种方法成本高昂、耗时，并且经常会出现注释者之间的不一致问题。 这些可扩展性限制催生了; however, this approach is prohibitively costly, time-consuming, and often suffers from inter-annotator inconsistency. These scalability constraints have catalyzed the emergence of the法官法学硕士LLM-as-a-Judge范式paradigm(Chiang et al., 2024; Li et al., 2024; Zhu et al., 2023)，它利用语言模型作为, which utilizes language models as自动评估器automated evaluators提供结构化的分数和可解释的理由。 最近的进展通过以下方式进一步将其扩展到多模式领域to provide structured scores and interpretable justifications. Recent advancements have further extended this to the multimodal domain throughMLLM 作为法官MLLM-as-a-Judge (Chen et al., 2024; Pu et al., 2025; Xiong et al., 2025; Ko et al., 2025; Waheed et al., 2025; Kim et al., 2024; Zhang et al., 2025)，实现大规模视觉语言反应的推理感知评估。, enabling reasoning-aware assessment of vision-language responses at scale.

尽管有潜力，现有的 MLLM 法官Despite their potential, existing MLLM judges(Chen et al., 2024; Xiong et al., 2025; Ko et al., 2025)通常会产生语言上合理但视觉上毫无根据的评估，我们将这种现象形式化为often produce linguistically plausible yet visually ungrounded evaluations, a phenomenon we formalize as知觉判断偏差Perceptual Judgment Bias (Section˜3.2）。 这种偏差代表了人类判断的系统性偏差，其根源在于两种不同的故障模式：). This bias represents a systematic deviation from human judgment rooted in two distinct failure modes:(a) 感知能力不足(a) insufficient perceptual capability，由于视觉理解不准确，法官过度奖励逻辑上连贯但视觉上不正确的反应（, where the judge over-rewards logically coherent but visually incorrect responses due to inaccurate visual understanding (Figure˜1a），和a), and(b) 响应锚定(b) response anchoring，法官未能根据自己的看法做出决定，而是默认响应文本中提供的视觉描述（, where the judge fails to ground its decision in its own perception, instead defaulting to visual descriptions provided within the response text (Figure˜1b). 总之，这些行为揭示了感知和推理之间的根本失调，表明当前的评估者经常优先考虑语言的一致性而不是直接的视觉证据。 这种偏见的形式化强调了评估框架的必要性，该框架明确执行基于感知的验证作为推理的先决条件，从而激发了我们提出的感知引导范式。b). Together, these behaviors reveal a fundamental misalignment between perception and reasoning, suggesting that current evaluators often prioritize linguistic consistency over direct visual evidence. The formalization of this bias underscores the necessity for evaluation frameworks that explicitly enforce perception-based verification as a prerequisite for reasoning, thereby motivating our proposed perception-guided paradigm.

为了解决这些限制，我们建议To address these limitations, we propose感知判断Perception-Judge，一种多模式评估器，可增强模型评估中的感知基础。 我们首先量化, a multimodal evaluator that reinforces perceptual grounding in model assessment. We first quantify知觉判断偏差Perceptual Judgment Bias in Section˜3.2通过将基线判断错误分解为两种失败模式：感知能力不足和反应锚定。 量化为by decomposing baseline judgment errors into two failure modes: insufficient perceptual capability and response anchoring. As quantified inTable˜1，基线判断的总体错误率超过 20%，表明两种故障模式都会降低判断性能。 通过受控视觉扰动进行更详细的分析进一步表明，基线法官可以可靠地识别具有复合错误的响应，达到 0.8 以上的高精度。然而，当错误仅局限于感知不一致时，它们的性能会大幅下降 10% 以上（, baseline judges incur substantial overall error rates exceeding 20%, indicating that both failure modes degrade judgment performance. A more detailed analysis with controlled visual perturbations further reveals that baseline judges can reliably identify responses with compound errors, achieving high accuracy above 0.8. However, when the error is isolated to perceptual inconsistency alone, their performance drops substantially by over 10% (Figure˜2）。 这些观察结果激励评估者明确强制执行感知验证，作为可靠判断的先决条件。 为了减轻这种偏差，我们构建了). These observations motivate an evaluator that explicitly enforces perceptual verification as a prerequisite for reliable judgment. To mitigate this bias, we construct the感知扰动判断数据集 (PPJD)Perceptually Perturbed Judgment Dataset (PPJD) in Section˜3.3。 PPJD 通过将受控的视觉不一致注入其他正确的反应中，产生四胞胎，从而提供专门的训练基础. PPJD provides a specialized training foundation by injecting controlled visual inconsistencies into otherwise correct responses, producing quadruplets(xi,rc,rrp,rrp+r)(x_{i},r_{c},r_{r_{p}},r_{r_{p+r}})明确地将感知失败与推理错误区分开来。 与通用偏好数据集不同，PPJD 提供细粒度、可验证的监督，暴露微妙的感知故障，为感知感知对齐奠定坚实的基础。 使用 PPJD，我们设计了一个结构化奖励目标that explicitly disentangle perceptual failures from reasoning errors. Unlike generic preference datasets, PPJD provides fine-grained, verifiable supervision that exposes subtle perceptual failures, serving as a robust foundation for perception-aware alignment. Using PPJD, we design a structured reward objective inSection˜3.4这要求法官区分完全正确的反应和表现出感知错误的反应，同时通过明确的分级顺序进一步区分感知和推理错误共同出现的情况。 通过强制执行感知验证作为高奖励的先决条件，这种设计可以防止法官在视觉基础不正确时根据推理合理性或响应描述的线索过度奖励响应。that requires judges to distinguish fully correct responses from those exhibiting perceptual errors, while further differentiating cases where perceptual and reasoning errors jointly occur through an explicit graded ordering. By enforcing perceptual verification as a prerequisite for high rewards, this design prevents judges from over-rewarding responses based on reasoning plausibility or response-described cues when visual grounding is incorrect.

该框架从而实现了感知感知评估，并有效减轻了先前模型中观察到的偏差。 根据经验，我们的方法在整个评估协议中提供了一致的性能增益。 它在 Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking 上将批量级指标提高了 11%，在 Flex-Judge-7B 上将单分数预测精度提高了 15%。 它还在基于分数的设置中与领先的专有评估器的性能相匹配，并在批次级一致性方面超越了其中许多评估器。 这项工作为在可验证但不可微分的监督下培训评估者建立了一个原则框架，从而实现大规模可靠且感知感知的多模态判断。This framework thereby achieves perception-aware evaluation and effectively mitigates the bias observed in prior models. Empirically, our approach delivers consistent performance gains across evaluation protocols. It improves batch-level metrics by up to 11% on Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking and increases single-score prediction accuracy by 15% on Flex-Judge-7B. It also matches the performance of leading proprietary evaluators in score-based settings and surpasses many of them in batch-level consistency. This work establishes a principled framework for training evaluators under verifiable but non-differentiable supervision, enabling reliable and perception-aware multimodal judgment at scale.

2 背景与初步Background & Preliminary

MLLM 作为法官和视觉推理。MLLM-as-a-Judge & Visual Reasoning.先前的工作已经广泛探索了Prior work has extensively explored the法官法学硕士LLM-as-a-Judge范例，其中语言模型评估模型生成的响应的质量paradigm, where language models evaluate the quality of model-generated responses(Chiang et al., 2024; Li et al., 2024, 2025a; Thakur et al., 2025; Whitehouse et al., 2025; Saha et al., 2025; Chen et al., 2025a; Zhu et al., 2023)。 最近的研究进一步结合强化学习（RL）和可验证的奖励方案来提高评分可靠性和偏好一致性. Recent studies further incorporate reinforcement learning (RL) and verifiable reward schemes to improve scoring reliability and preference consistency(Whitehouse et al., 2025; Chen et al., 2025a; Su et al., 2025; Wen et al., 2025; Yuan et al., 2024)。 该范例已扩展到多模式设置. This paradigm has been extended to multimodal settings asMLLM 作为法官MLLM-as-a-Judge，实现视觉语言评估，但现有方法主要依赖于监督微调，并且经常遭受视觉感知判断偏差, enabling vision-language evaluation, but existing approaches mainly rely on supervised fine-tuning and often suffer from visual perception judgment bias(Chen et al., 2024; Ko et al., 2025; Pu et al., 2025; Waheed et al., 2025; Lee et al., 2024; Xiong et al., 2025)。 与此同时，最近的研究表明 MLLM 经常在视觉感知和基础方面遇到困难，并提出了免训练方法、基于 RL 的优化和以数据为中心的策略来改善视觉推理. In parallel, recent works show that MLLMs frequently struggle with visual perception and grounding, and propose training-free methods, RL-based optimization, and data-centric strategies to improve visual reasoning(Chen et al., 2025b; Jian et al., 2025; Tian et al., 2025; Wang et al., 2025b; Chen et al., 2025c; Bigverdi et al., 2025)。 附录中提供了更全面的审查. A more comprehensive review is provided in the appendixAppendix˜B.

3 提议的方法Proposed Method

我们的目标是通过解决多模式法学硕士法官中观察到的感知判断偏差来提高多模式评估的可靠性。 我们首先定义We aim to improve the reliability of multimodal evaluation by addressing the perceptual judgment bias observed in multimodal LLM judges. We first define theMLLM 作为法官MLLM-as-a-Judge正式确定多模式评估设置的任务（task to formalize the multimodal evaluation setting (Section˜3.1）。 接下来，我们识别). Next, we identify the知觉判断偏差Perceptual Judgment Bias，法官优先考虑响应描述的线索或推理的合理性，而不是他们自己的视觉感知。 这种偏差是通过对照案例研究进行实证分析的，这些案例比较了视觉扰动下人类和模型的决策（, where the judge prioritizes response-described cues or reasoning plausibility over their own visual perception. This bias is empirically analyzed through controlled case studies that compare human and model decisions under visual perturbations (Section˜3.2）。 为了缓解这个问题，我们构建了). To mitigate this issue, we construct the感知干扰判断数据集Perceptually Perturbed Judgment Dataset（PPJD）（(PPJD) (Section˜3.3）。 该数据集采用感知感知判断设计，在保留原始推理的同时最大限度地减少视觉基础属性的改变，从而实现暴露感知错误的反事实响应。 在此基础上，我们开发了一个基于 GRPO 的可验证奖励建模框架，). The dataset utilizes a perception-aware judgment design that minimally alters visually grounded attributes while preserving the original reasoning, enabling counterfactual responses that expose perception errors. Building on this foundation, we develop a GRPO-based verifiable reward modeling framework,感知法官Perception Judge，它优化了法官与人类评估的感知一致性（, which optimizes the judge for perceptual alignment with human evaluations (Section˜3.4).

3.1 问题定义：MLLM 作为法官Problem Definition: MLLM-as-a-Judge

3.2 知觉判断偏差Perceptual Judgment Bias

理想情况下，多模式法官应根据以下两个方面来评估响应：Ideally, a multimodal judge should evaluate a response based on both its正确性correctness和法官的and the judge’s自己的认知own perception输入图像的of the input imageviv_{i}。 然而，在实践中，MLLM 法官系统性地未能惩罚视觉主张与图像相矛盾的反应，要么是因为他们本身误解了图像，要么是因为即使他们自己的感知是正确的，他们也未能标记错误的视觉主张。 我们称这种现象为. In practice, however, MLLM judges systematically fail to penalize responses whose visual claims contradict the image, either because they misperceive the image themselves or because they fail to flag the false visual claims even when their own perception is correct. We term this phenomenon知觉判断偏差Perceptual Judgment Bias。 正式地，让. 3.3 通过感知扰动生成数据Data Generation via Perceptual Perturbation

为了调查和减轻多模态推理中的感知判断偏差，我们构建了To investigate and mitigate perceptual judgment bias in multimodal reasoning, we construct the感知扰动判断数据集 (PPJD)Perceptually Perturbed Judgment Dataset (PPJD)，它明确地消除了感知和推理的不一致。 基于可靠判断应随感知差异而变化的原则，PPJD 能够系统分析模型如何在评估中纳入视觉证据。 从多模式偏好数据集 MMPR 开始, which explicitly disentangles perceptual and reasoning inconsistencies. Grounded in the principle that reliable judgment should vary with perceptual differences, PPJD enables systematic analysis of how models incorporate visual evidence in their evaluations. Starting from the multimodal preference dataset MMPR(Wang et al., 2024)，它提供了, which provides选择的chosen和and被拒绝rejected回应responsesrcr_{\texttt{c}}和andrrr_{\texttt{r}}分别为每个输入respectively for each input(xi={qi,vi})(x_{i}=\{q_{i},v_{i}\})，我们保留, we retainrcr_{\texttt{c}}作为感知和逻辑上一致的参考。as the perceptually and logically consistent reference.

然后我们生成一个视觉上不一致但推理保留的响应We then generate a visually inconsistent but reasoning-preserved responserrpr_{\texttt{r}_{\textit{p}}}通过应用受控by applying a controlled知觉扰动perceptual perturbation (p) 到) torcr_{\texttt{c}}使用生成模型（例如 GPTusing a generative model (e.g., GPT(Achiam et al., 2023), 琪文, Qwen(Bai et al., 2023; Yang et al., 2025)）或预训练的判断模型) or a pretrained judge modelℳJudge\mathcal{M}_{\text{Judge}}。 具体来说，扰动修改了原始响应中提到的视觉基础属性（例如，物体颜色、计数或空间关系），这些属性在先前的多模态感知误差研究中通常被分析. Specifically, the perturbation modifies visually grounded attributes (e.g., object color, count, or spatial relations) mentioned in the original response, which are commonly analyzed in prior studies on multimodal perception errors(Vo et al., 2025; Qian et al., 2024)，同时保持整体语言流畅性和推理逻辑，如图所示, while preserving overall linguistic fluency and reasoning logic, as illustrated inFigure˜3。 为了确保忠实地反映扰动，我们通过将其答案与相应视觉问题的真实参考的一致性进行比较来自动验证每个生成的响应，并丢弃扰动无法改变预期属性的情况。 这种方法的灵感来自于经验观察，即多模式法学硕士在被指示时表现出更高的可控性和精度. To ensure that the perturbations are faithfully reflected, we automatically verify each generated response by comparing its answer consistency with the ground-truth reference for the corresponding visual question, discarding cases where the perturbation fails to alter the intended attribute. This approach is motivated by the empirical observation that multimodal LLMs exhibit higher controllability and precision when instructed to生成generate微妙的知觉不一致，而不是当任务时subtle perceptual inconsistencies rather than when tasked to检测detect它们，能够稳定地合成现实但受控的视觉错误them, enabling stable synthesis of realistic yet controlled visual errors(Jiang et al., 2024; Qian et al., 2024).

为了进一步解耦感知和推理维度，我们综合了一个额外的响应To further decouple perceptual and reasoning dimensions, we synthesize an additional responserrp+rr_{\texttt{r}_{\textit{p+r}}}通过介绍两者by introducing both感知和推理不一致perceptual and reasoning inconsistencies (p+r），导致样品完全降解。 每个实例因此形成一个四元组), resulting in a fully degraded sample. Each instance thus forms a quadruplet(xi,rc,rrp,rrp+r)(x_{i},r_{\texttt{c}},r_{\texttt{r}_{\textit{p}}},r_{\texttt{r}_{\textit{p+r}}})代表 (i) 给定的文本和视觉输入，(ii) 正确的 (representing (i) the given textual and visual input, (ii) the correct (选择的chosen), (iii) 感知上受到干扰的 (), (iii) the perceptually perturbed (rejected1\texttt{rejected}_{1}），以及（iv）感知和逻辑上不一致的反应（), and (iv) the perceptually and logically inconsistent responses (rejected2\texttt{rejected}_{2}).

PPJD 旨在为可验证的判断学习提供细粒度的监督，使判断者能够学习明确的排序关系，例如The PPJD is designed to provide fine-grained supervision for verifiable judgment learning, enabling the judge to learn explicit ordering relationships such asrc≻rrp≻rrp+rr_{\texttt{c}}\succ r_{\texttt{r}_{\textit{p}}}\succ r_{\texttt{r}_{\textit{p+r}}}。 在实践中，这种结构有效地实现了预期的指导，并且由此产生的四元组作为奖励建模和优化框架的基础. 3.4 可验证的奖励模型Verifiable Reward Modeling

我们设计了一个可验证的奖励计划We design a verifiable reward scheme(Wen et al., 2025; Su et al., 2025)这鼓励基于感知和人性化的判断，同时惩罚过度依赖响应描述的线索或表面推理。 法官MLLM，that encourages perceptually grounded and human-aligned judgments while penalizing over-reliance on response-described cues or surface-level reasoning. The judge MLLM,ℳJudge\mathcal{M}_{\texttt{Judge}}，接受组相对策略优化 (GRPO) 训练, is trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)(Shao et al., 2024; DeepSeek-AI et al., 2025)使用四联体using quadruplets(xi,rc,rrp,rrp+r)(x_{i},\ r_{\texttt{c}},\ r_{\texttt{r}_{\textit{p}}},\ r_{\texttt{r}_{\textit{p+r}}}), 其中, wherercr_{\texttt{c}}是经过验证的is the verified选择的chosen回应，response,rrpr_{\texttt{r}_{\textit{p}}}是感知受到干扰is the perception-perturbedrejected1\texttt{rejected}_{1}响应，以及response, andrrp+rr_{\texttt{r}_{\textit{p+r}}}包含感知和推理扰动（contains both perceptual and reasoning perturbations (rejected2\texttt{rejected}_{2}）。 让). Letoio_{i}表示模型生成的输入判决（推理-答案输出）denote the model-generated verdict (reasoning–answer output) for inputxix_{i}。 GRPO 优化分组响应中的相对优势，而不需要价值函数，从而实现稳定且可扩展的对齐。 这一属性自然地与我们的环境保持一致，其中每个四元组形成一个可验证的偏好组，表现出分级的感知和推理退化。. GRPO optimizes relative advantages within grouped responses without requiring a value function, leading to stable and scalable alignment. This property aligns naturally with our setting, where each quadruplet forms a verifiable preference group exhibiting graded perceptual and reasoning degradation.

结构性奖励。Structural Reward.在评估感知或推理质量之前，法官必须产生遵循一致推理-答案模式的可验证输出。 此步骤保证了句法和语义的有效性，确保只有格式良好的响应才有助于后续奖励。 法官做出文字判决，Before evaluating perceptual or reasoning quality, the judge must produce verifiable outputs that follow a consistent reasoning–answer pattern. This step guarantees syntactic and semantic validity, ensuring that only well-formed responses contribute to subsequent rewards. 为了确保统一且可解释的缩放，奖励值均匀分布在离散的排名正确性级别上，为更接近目标顺序的排列分配更高的奖励。 该公式保留了一致的奖励间隔，而不依赖于特定于任务的启发法。To ensure uniform and interpretable scaling, the reward values are distributed evenly across discrete ranking correctness levels, assigning higher rewards to permutations closer to the target order. This formulation preserves consistent reward intervals without relying on task-specific heuristics.

统一的可验证奖励和优化。Unified Verifiable Reward and Optimization.最后，我们将所有组件整合到一个统一的可验证目标中，该目标结合了结构有效性和全球排名一致性。 这种层次化的表述确保了判断模型能够在扰动尺度上产生结构有效、感知忠实且与人类一致的判断。 每个实例的总奖励是批次组件的格式门控乘积，如下所示：Finally, we integrate all components into a unified verifiable objective that combines structural validity and global ranking consistency. 我们使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）来训练法官模型We train the judge model using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)(Shao et al., 2024; DeepSeek-AI et al., 2025), 统一可验证的奖励, where the unified verifiable rewardℛ​(oi)\mathcal{R}(o_{i})定义于defined inEquation˜8被纳入 GRPO 目标中is incorporated into the GRPO objective inEquation˜1。 这种联合表述使模型能够以稳定且可扩展的方式将其判断行为与基于感知的监督结合起来。. This joint formulation allows the model to align its judgment behavior with perceptually grounded supervision in a stable and scalable manner.

4 实验Experiments

4.1 实验装置Experimental Setup

Following the procedure described inSection˜3.3，我们提取 3k 个高质量对来形成 PPJD 训练集。 补充材料中提供了其他统计数据和数据集构建详细信息（, we extract 3k high-quality pairs to form the PPJD training set. 基线。Baselines.我们将 Perception-Judge 与具有高 API 使用成本的竞争性商业专有 MLLM 进行比较We compare our Perception-Judge against competitive commercial proprietary MLLMs with high API usage costs(Achiam et al., 2023; Comanici et al., 2025)以及需要大量策划训练集的开源模型, as well as open-source models that either require substantial curated training sets(Lee et al., 2024; Xiong et al., 2025)或者依赖更大的模型尺寸or rely on significantly larger model sizes(Liu et al., 2023).

4.2 绩效评估Performance Evaluation

定量结果。Quantitative Results.我们在 MLLM-as-a-Judge 基准上评估我们经过微调的多模式法官，总结如下：We evaluate our fine-tuned multimodal judge on the MLLM-as-a-Judge benchmark as summarized inTable˜2。 我们的模型在大多数评估设置中显示出一致的改进。 具体来说，我们的方法比最先进的 Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking 表现出显着的进步. Our model shows consistent improvements across most evaluation settings. Specifically, our method exhibits substantial gains over the state-of-the-art Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking(Yang et al., 2025)，显示成对评估提高了 4%，批量评估提高了 11%。 此外，即使在训练过程中没有使用明确的分数标签，我们的方法在单分数评分任务中也能显着提高 12%。 这表明我们的模型通过相对偏好奖励建模有效地学习了标量评估能力。, showing improvements of 4% in pairwise evaluations and 11% in batch-level evaluations. Moreover, even though no explicit score labels are used during training, our method yields a remarkable increase of 12% in single-score grading tasks. This suggests that our model effectively learns the scalar evaluation capability through relative preference reward modeling.

总体而言，我们的微调模型不仅超过了现有的开源 MLLM，而且还实现了与领先的基于 LLM 的专有评估器（例如 GPT-4o）相当的性能Overall, our fine-tuned model not only exceeds existing open-source MLLMs but also achieves performance comparable to leading proprietary LLM-based evaluators such as GPT-4o(Hurst et al., 2024)在单分数预测模式下。 值得注意的是，我们的模型在批次级评估中也优于大多数专有的法学硕士，该模型在多响应比较中表现出更强的全局一致性。in single-score prediction mode. Notably, our model also outperforms most proprietary LLMs in the batch-level evaluation, where the model demonstrates stronger global consistency across multi-response comparisons.

我们将这些改进归因于我们的相对概念感知训练数据集，这鼓励模型对样本间关系进行推理，而不是依赖于表面模式。 为了验证偏差的减少，我们分析了该模型在识别针对感知扰动的正确响应方面的准确性We attribute these improvements to our relative concept-aware training dataset, which encourages the model to reason over inter-sample relations rather than relying on superficial patterns. To validate the reduction in bias, we analyze the model’s accuracy in identifying corrected responses against perception-perturbed ones inFigure˜2。结果定量地表明，我们的方法有效地减轻了感知和推理偏差。. The results quantitatively demonstrate that our approach effectively mitigates perceptual and reasoning biases.

我们在 InfographicVQA 和 MathVista 上的结果进一步证实了这种增强的稳健性，我们的模型在所有三种评估设置中都取得了一致的收益。鉴于这些基准需要精确的光学字符识别 (OCR) 和数学推理，这些改进强烈表明我们的训练策略成功增强了模型的感知相关推理能力。This enhanced robustness is further corroborated by our results on InfographicVQA and MathVista, where our model achieves consistent gains across all three evaluation settings. Given that these benchmarks necessitate precise optical character recognition (OCR) and mathematical reasoning, these improvements strongly suggest that our training strategy successfully enhances the model’s capacity for perception-related reasoning.

而 LLaVA-CriticWhile LLaVA-Critic(Xiong et al., 2025)在成对设置中获得更高分数，它是在 LLaVA-Critic-113k 语料库上进行训练的。 相比之下，我们的模型在紧凑的 3k 数据集上进行了微调，该数据集经过精心策划，与所有评估基准完全脱节。 这证明了我们的方法具有卓越的数据效率，可以在显着减少监管的情况下实现具有竞争力的性能。attains higher scores in the pairwise setting, it is trained on the LLaVA-Critic-113k corpus. In contrast, our model is fine-tuned on a compact 3k dataset that is carefully curated to be fully disjoint from all evaluation benchmarks. This demonstrates the exceptional data efficiency of our approach, achieving competitive performance with significantly less supervision.

4.3 消融研究Ablation Study

在本节中，我们解决两个问题：（1）我们提出的 PPJD 数据集（In this section, we address two questions: (1) What advantages does our proposed PPJD dataset (Section˜3.3) 优于现有 MMPR-v1.2) offer over the existing MMPR-v1.2(Wang et al., 2024)训练期间的数据集？ （2）如何引入奖励设计dataset during training? (2) How do the reward designs introduced inSection˜3.4影响模型性能？为此，我们在三种配置下对 Flex-Judge-VL-7B 进行微调，每种配置都控制为利用 10k 训练样本进行公平比较：(i) MMPR-v1.2affect model performance? To this end, we fine-tune Flex-Judge-VL-7B under three configurations, each controlled to utilize 10k training samples for fair comparison: (i) MMPR-v1.2(Wang et al., 2024)具有成对奖励，(ii) 具有成对奖励的 PPJD，以及 (iii) 具有批次排名奖励的 PPJD。对于成对奖励，我们使用二元奖励，当所选响应的得分高于其对应响应时，该奖励分配 1，否则分配 0。对于 PPJD，我们构建偏好对为with pairwise reward, (ii) PPJD with pairwise reward, and (iii) PPJD with batch ranking reward. For pairwise reward, we use a binary reward that assigns 1 when the chosen response receives a higher score than its counterpart, and 0 otherwise. For PPJD, we construct preference pairs as(rc,rrp)(r_{\texttt{c}},r_{\texttt{r}_{\textit{p}}})和and(rrp,rrp+r)(r_{\texttt{r}_{\textit{p}}},r_{\texttt{r}_{\textit{p+r}}})，并应用相同的成对奖励，使模型能够从校正感知和感知扰动比较中学习。, and apply the same pairwise reward, enabling the model to learn from both corrected–perceptual and perceptual–perturbed comparisons.

数据集的影响。Effect of Datasets.为了隔离 PPJD 的贡献，我们将 MMPR-v1.2 与成对奖励进行比较（To isolate the contribution of PPJD, we compare MMPR-v1.2 with pairwise reward (2nd2^{\text{nd}}行）与 PPJD 的配对奖励（row) against PPJD with pairwise reward (3rd3^{\text{rd}}行）。使用 PPJD 替换训练数据的 MMPR-v1.2 可在所有指标上产生一致的改进。由于 PPJD 通过显式编码感知校正row). Replacing MMPR-v1.2 with PPJD for training data yields consistent improvements across all metrics. Since PPJD explicitly encodes perceptual corrections through(rc,rrp,rrp+r)(r_{\texttt{c}},r_{\texttt{r}_{\textit{p}}},r_{\texttt{r}_{\textit{p+r}}})，这些成果表明，直接减轻训练数据中的感知判断偏差会比仅对通用模型进行训练带来更可靠的多模态评估, these gains indicate that directly mitigating perceptual judgment bias in the training data leads to more reliable multimodal evaluation than training solely on generic(chosen,rejected)(\texttt{chosen},\texttt{rejected})对。pairs.

奖励的效果。Effect of Rewards.为了比较奖励的效果，我们用成对奖励来检查 PPJD（To compare the effect of rewards, we examine PPJD with pairwise reward (3rd3^{\text{rd}}row）与 PPJD 的批量排名奖励（row) against PPJD with batch ranking reward (4th4^{\text{th}}行）。仅使用批量排名目标可以在基于分数和成对指标上产生更高的性能。这是特别值得注意的，因为批量奖励从不观察明确的成对或分数标签；相反，它在每批中强制执行全局一致的候选排序。这些结果表明，全局排名监督不仅足以提高集合级别的排名，而且还足以诱导准确的本地偏好和经过良好校准的分数预测。row). Using only the batch ranking objective yields higher performance on both score-based and pairwise metrics. This is particularly notable because the batch reward never observes explicit pairwise or score labels; instead, it enforces a globally consistent ordering of candidates within each batch. These results suggest that global ranking supervision is sufficient not only for improving set-level rankings, but also for inducing accurate local preferences and well-calibrated score predictions.

5 结论Conclusion

这项工作系统地研究了基于多模式法学硕士的法官的感知可靠性，并确定了This work systematically investigates perceptual reliability in multimodal LLM-based judges and identifies知觉判断偏差Perceptual Judgment Bias，一种基本的失败模式，其中模型优先考虑语言合理性而不是视觉正确性，导致与人类评估的系统性分歧。 为了解决这个限制，我们提出了一个基于感知引导的培训框架, a fundamental failure mode in which models prioritize linguistic plausibility over visual correctness, leading to systematic divergence from human evaluation. To address this limitation, we propose a perception-guided training framework built upon the感知扰动判断数据集 (PPJD)Perceptually Perturbed Judgment Dataset (PPJD)以及基于 GRPO 的统一优化and a unified GRPO-based optimization with结构化批量奖励建模structured batch reward modeling，无需明确的成对标签即可实现细粒度、可验证的监督和全球一致的排名。 跨不同基准的广泛实验表明，感知保真度、排名一致性以及与人类判断的一致性都有显着改善，为稳健、可解释和可扩展的多模式评估奠定了原则基础。, enabling fine-grained, verifiable supervision and globally consistent ranking without explicit pairwise labels. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate substantial improvements in perceptual fidelity, ranking coherence, and alignment with human judgments, establishing a principled foundation for robust, interpretable, and scalable multimodal evaluation.

影响报告Impact Statement

这项工作旨在通过提高自动化多模式评估器的可靠性和公平性来推进机器学习领域。通过减轻感知判断偏差，我们的框架支持开发更透明、更好地基于视觉证据、更符合人类判断的评估系统。随着 MLLM 应用于准确的视觉理解和忠实评估至关重要的环境中，这一进步变得越来越重要。This work aims to advance the field of machine learning by improving the reliability and fairness of automated multimodal evaluators. By mitigating perceptual judgment bias, our framework supports the development of evaluation systems that are more transparent, better grounded in visual evidence, and more closely aligned with human judgment. This advancement is increasingly relevant as MLLMs are applied in settings where accurate visual understanding and faithful evaluation are critical.

更广泛地说，如果自动化法官在后续决策中取代人类监督，就会出现潜在的社会风险。尽管我们的方法降低了评估成本和对广泛人工注释的依赖，但残余偏差和失败模式可能仍然存在，特别是在主观、模糊或分布外的情况下。如果此类系统被视为权威机构，这些风险可能会放大。因此，我们建议部署 MLLM 作为法官系统作为决策支持工具，并在高风险环境中辅以人工审查和适合领域的审计。More broadly, potential societal risks arise if automated judges replace human oversight in consequential decision-making. Although our approach reduces the cost of evaluation and the reliance on extensive human annotation, residual biases and failure modes may persist, particularly in subjective, ambiguous, or out-of-distribution cases. These risks could be amplified if such systems are treated as definitive authorities. We therefore recommend deploying MLLM-as-a-Judge systems as decision-support tools, complemented by human review and domain-appropriate auditing in high-stakes environments.

附录AAppendix A局限性和未来的工作Limitations & Future Work

尽管我们的方法展示了具有竞争力的性能，并在实际多模式评估中表现出明显的潜力，但仍有几个方面有待进一步探索。 首先，在某些具有挑战性的场景中，当前的法官表现仍然落后于人类注释专家。 这一差距表明有机会改进推理程序并扩大训练期间使用的偏好信号的多样性。 其次，与 DPO 等方法相比，该训练方法需要更大的计算量，特别是在进行多轮采样时。 在保持鲁棒性的同时减少计算开销将进一步提高我们框架的实用性。Although our approach demonstrates competitive performance and presents clear potential for practical multimodal evaluation, several aspects remain open for further exploration. First, the current judge performance still trails behind expert human annotators in certain challenging scenarios. This gap suggests an opportunity to refine the reasoning procedure and expand the diversity of preference signals used during training. Second, the training method requires larger computation compared with approaches such as DPO, especially when operating over multiple sampling rounds. Reducing computational overhead while maintaining robustness would further increase the practicality of our framework.

另一个限制是对生成监控信号的专有模型的依赖。 虽然这种选择可以实现高质量的指导，但未来的工作可以探索自我蒸馏Another limitation is the dependency on proprietary models for generating supervisory signals. While this choice enables high-quality guidance, future work could explore self-distillation(Yuan et al., 2024; Sun et al., 2023; Saha et al., 2025)使用功能强大的开源模型，例如 Qwenusing capable open-source models, such as Qwen(Bai et al., 2023)。 这个方向有可能提高再现性并扩大在访问封闭模型受到限制的环境中的适用性。 将方法扩展到更大的模型尺度也仍然是重要的一步。. This direction has the potential to improve reproducibility and broaden applicability in settings where access to closed models is restricted. Extending the method to larger model scales also remains an important step.

此外，主观评价的某些方面仍然具有挑战性。 尽管所提出的程序减少了变异性，但多模态解释中仍然可能出现细微的歧义，并且即使在过滤之后，推理过程中的残留噪声也可能会影响结果。In addition, certain aspects of subjective evaluation remain challenging. Although the proposed procedure reduces variability, subtle ambiguities in multimodal interpretation can still occur, and residual noise in the reasoning process may influence outcomes even after filtering.

总的来说，我们的方法为多模式评估奠定了坚实的基础，并为未来的发展开辟了几条有希望的道路。Overall, our method lays a strong foundation for multimodal evaluation and opens several promising paths for future development.

附录BAppendix B相关工作Related Work

法学硕士作为法官。LLM-as-a-Judge.的The法官法学硕士LLM-as-a-Judge范式paradigm(Chiang et al., 2024; Li et al., 2024, 2025a; Thakur et al., 2025; Whitehouse et al., 2025; Saha et al., 2025; Chen et al., 2025a; Zhu et al., 2023)使用语言模型作为其他法学硕士产生的回答的评估器。 普罗米修斯等模型employs language models as evaluators of responses produced by other LLMs. Models such as Prometheus(Kim et al., 2024; Lee et al., 2024)提供直接评分或成对比较。 近期作品provide direct scoring or pairwise comparison. Recent works(Whitehouse et al., 2025; Chen et al., 2025a)进一步将强化学习（RL）与可验证的奖励计划结合起来further incorporate reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable reward schemes(Su et al., 2025; Wen et al., 2025; Yuan et al., 2024)，通常由 (1) 模型指定分数和人工注释分数之间的差异组成, typically composed of (1) the difference between model-assigned and human-annotated scores(Chen et al., 2025a)，（2）成对偏好的正确性和一致性, (2) correctness and consistency of pairwise preferences(Whitehouse et al., 2025; Saha et al., 2025)，（3）结构性奖励确保有效的输出格式或分数范围。, and (3) structural rewards ensuring valid output formats or score ranges.

的TheMLLM 作为法官MLLM-as-a-Judge框架framework(Chen et al., 2024; Ko et al., 2025; Pu et al., 2025; Waheed et al., 2025; Lee et al., 2024; Xiong et al., 2025)将这一想法扩展到多模式评估，使模型能够评估视觉-语言反应。 然而，现有的方法主要依赖于有监督的微调，而不是基于强化学习的优化，并且当前的多模态法官经常表现出extends this idea to multimodal evaluation, enabling models to assess vision–language responses. However, existing approaches mainly rely on supervised fine-tuning rather than RL-based optimization, and current multimodal judges often exhibit视觉感知判断偏差visual perception judgment bias，倾向于语言的合理性而不是感知的正确性。 我们的工作通过引入基于强化学习的训练框架来解决这一限制，该框架通过可验证的奖励明确强化基于感知的判断。, favoring linguistic plausibility over perceptual correctness. Our work addresses this limitation by introducing an RL-based training framework that explicitly reinforces perception-grounded judgment through verifiable rewards.

视觉感知和视觉推理。Visual Perception and Visual Reasoning.最近的研究表明，MLLM 由于视觉感知能力有限，常常难以完成视觉推理任务Recent studies have revealed that MLLMs often struggle with visual reasoning tasks due to their limited visual perception capabilities(Chen et al., 2025b; Jian et al., 2025; Tian et al., 2025; Wang et al., 2025b; Chen et al., 2025c; Bigverdi et al., 2025)。 一系列作品将这种限制归因于当文本序列长度主导视觉标记数量时对视觉信息的关注不足。 自适应视觉系统. A series of works identifies this limitation as stemming from the under-attention to visual information when the textual sequence length dominates the number of visual tokens. ADAPTVIS(Chen et al., 2025b)通过基于置信度标准动态地重新加权视觉标记的注意力来解决这个问题，以免训练的方式改善视觉感知。 反射-Vaddresses this issue by dynamically re-weighting the attention of visual tokens based on confidence criteria, improving visual perception in a training-free manner. Reflection-V(Jian et al., 2025)采用强化学习方法，该方法使用来自视觉标记注意力值的奖励，促进基于视觉信息的推理。 VAPOadopts an RL approach that uses rewards derived from visual-token attention values, promoting reasoning grounded in visual information. VAPO(Tian et al., 2025)通过将视觉感知问题随机插入到文本推理序列中来增强推理数据集，并使用 RL 训练模型来回答这些问题，从而鼓励在推理过程中更多地关注视觉信息。augments reasoning datasets by randomly inserting visual perception questions into textual reasoning sequences and trains the model with RL to answer them, encouraging greater attention to visual information during reasoning.

另一项研究开发了增强视觉感知的补充方法。 帕帕Another line of research develops complementary approaches to enhance visual perception. PAPO(Wang et al., 2025b)收集从损坏的图像输入生成的负面响应，以帮助模型区分正确的推理和感知退化的推理。 米可collects negative responses generated from corrupted image inputs to help models distinguish correct reasoning from perceptually degraded reasoning. MiCo(Chen et al., 2025c)教导 MLLM 辨别图像是否是原始图像的增强版本，从而提高视觉推理能力。 拉瓦-极光teaches MLLMs to discriminate whether an image is an augmented version of the original, thereby improving visual reasoning ability. LLaVA-AURORA(Bigverdi et al., 2025)提出感知标记，将内在图像特征嵌入作为推理标记以增强视觉推理。 与之前主要增强推理过程中的感知基础的研究不同，我们的工作重点是在多模态判断的背景下提升感知本身。proposes perception tokens, which embed intrinsic image features as reasoning tokens to enhance visual reasoning. Unlike prior studies that primarily enhance perceptual grounding within the reasoning process, our work focuses on elevating perception itself in the context of multimodal judgment.

C.2 实现细节和超参数Implementation Details & Hyperparameters

Perception-Judge 由两个模型初始化：Flex-Judge-VL 和 Qwen3-VL-Thinking。两种模型均使用组相对策略优化 (GRPO) 进行优化，每个提示有 5 次推出。 在 PPJD 数据集上进行一个 epoch 的训练，全局批量大小为 512。我们采用固定学习率Perception-Judge is initialized from two models: Flex-Judge-VL and Qwen3-VL-Thinking. Both models are optimized using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with five rollouts per prompt. Training is conducted for one epoch on the PPJD dataset with a global batch size of 512. We employ a fixed learning rate of2.5×10−72.5\times 10^{-7}对于 Flex-Judge-VL 和for Flex-Judge-VL and7.5×10−77.5\times 10^{-7}对于 Qwen3-VL-Thinking。 所有奖励组件和结构验证器都遵循主论文中描述的公式。 提示的最大序列长度设置为 4,096 个标记，响应的最大序列长度设置为 24,576 个标记。 对于 GRPO，我们使用裁剪for Qwen3-VL-Thinking. All reward components and structural validators follow the formulations described in the main paper. The maximum sequence length is set to 4,096 tokens for prompts and 24,576 tokens for responses. For GRPO, we use clipping withϵ=0.2\epsilon=0.2并将KL系数设置为and set the KL coefficient to0.010.01。 在所有实验中，我们使用的温度为. Throughout all experiments, we use a temperature of1.01.0和顶部 pand top-p of0.950.95用于采样。for sampling.

我们使用 8 个 NVIDIA H100 GPU 来训练 Perception-Judge-Flex，使用 8 个 NVIDIA H200 GPU 来训练 Perception-Judge-Qwen3。 推理遵循相同的模型配置，无需额外调整，并使用 MLLM-as-a-Judge 基准中定义的标准化评估协议We employed 8 NVIDIA H100 GPUs for training Perception-Judge-Flex and 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs for Perception-Judge-Qwen3. Inference follows the same model configuration without additional tuning and uses the standardized evaluation protocol defined in the MLLM-as-a-Judge benchmark(Chen et al., 2024)。 有关数据集构建的更多详细信息，请参阅. Additional details on the construction of the dataset are provided inAppendix˜D.

C.3 评估详情Evaluation Details

C.3.1 评估设置Evaluation Settings

在本节中，我们描述了实验中使用的评估协议，该协议遵循 MLLM 作为法官研究中常用的做法In this section, we describe the evaluation protocol used in our experiments, which follows the practices commonly adopted in MLLM-as-a-Judge research(Chen et al., 2024; Xiong et al., 2025; Ko et al., 2025)。 我们的目标是通过三种基本评估设置来评估法官模型与人类偏好（Judgement GT）的吻合程度：单分评分、成对比较和批次级别排名。 该协议集成了先前工作中的既定实践，包括 MLLM-as-a-Judge. Our goal is to assess how closely a judge model aligns with human preferences (Judgement GT) across three fundamental evaluation settings: single-score grading, pairwise comparison, and batch-level ranking. The protocol integrates established practices from prior work, including MLLM-as-a-Judge(Chen et al., 2024), 弹性判断, Flex-Judge(Ko et al., 2025)，以及相关的多模式和法学硕士评估基准, and related multimodal and LLM evaluation benchmarks(Pu et al., 2025; Li et al., 2025a).

Although the MLLM outputs scores on a 1 to 10 scale, we apply a simple deterministic post-processing step (simple division) to map them to the 1 to 5 range used in our evaluation.

成对比较提示。Pairwise Comparison Prompt.

用于成对评估的提示格式在The prompt format used for pairwise evaluations is provided inFigure˜S3。 生成答案后，我们应用一个简单的后处理步骤，通过比较两个分数或在它们落在同一范围内时分配平局来确定偏好关系。. After the answer generation, we apply a simple post-processing step that determines the preference relation by comparing the two scores or assigning a tie when they fall within the same range.

批次排名提示。Batch Ranking Prompt.

用于批次级排序的提示设计如图所示The prompt design used for batch-level ranking is illustrated inFigure˜S4。 然后，轻量级后处理步骤将模型分配的分数转换为候选集上的有序排名。. A lightweight post-processing step then converts the model’s assigned scores into an ordered ranking over the candidate set.

C.3.3 减少偏见Bias Mitigation

与之前的评估一致Consistent with prior evaluations(Chen et al., 2024; Ko et al., 2025)，我们应用两种策略来减少判断偏差：, we apply two strategies to reduce judgment bias:

  • •

    顺序随机化Order Randomization以减少成对和批量设置中的位置偏差。to reduce positional bias in pairwise and batch settings.

  • •

    领带处理Tie Handling当基准测试包含平局选项时，防止强制选择工件；当没有平局选项时，模型需要在候选者之间进行强制随机选择。when the benchmark includes a tie option, preventing forced-choice artifacts; when a tie option is not available, the model is required to make a forced random choice between the candidates.

C.4 基线Baselines

  • •

    LLaVA-评论家。LLaVA-Critic.LLaVA-评论家LLaVA-Critic(Xiong et al., 2025)是一个以评估为中心的 7B 多模态模型，在精选的综合评论数据集上进行了微调。 该模型旨在输出标量分数或成对偏好，并在事实验证中表现出强大的功效。 然而，值得注意的是，其训练语料库和当前评估基准之间的潜在重叠可能会导致性能膨胀。 尽管存在这种限制，它仍然是多模式评估的一个有价值的开源基线。is an evaluation-centric 7B multimodal model, fine-tuned on a curated dataset of synthetic critiques. The model is designed to output scalar scores or pairwise preferences and demonstrates robust efficacy in factuality verification. However, it is important to note that potential overlaps between its training corpus and current evaluation benchmarks may lead to performance inflation. Despite this limitation, it remains a valuable open-source baseline for multimodal evaluation.

  • •

    Qwen2.5-VL。Qwen2.5-VL. Qwen2.5-VL (Bai et al., 2023)是一个开源视觉语言模型系列（0.5B-72B），具有强大的 OCR 和场景理解能力。 7B 版本将 ViT 编码器与基于 LLaMA 的 LLM 集成，实现强大的 VQA 和多模态推理。 尽管没有接受过法官培训，但它通过指令提示执行可靠的零样本评估。is an open-source vision–language model family (0.5B–72B) with strong OCR and scene understanding. The 7B version integrates a ViT encoder with an LLaMA-based LLM, enabling robust VQA and multimodal reasoning. Although not trained as a judge, it performs reliable zero-shot evaluations through instruction prompting.

  • •

    Flex-Judge-VL。Flex-Judge-VL. Flex-Judge-VL (Ko et al., 2025)是一个 7B 多模态模型，专门针对高质量的基于文本的推理演示进行了训练。 建立在 JudgeLM 等以文本为中心的评估器范式之上is a 7B multimodal model trained exclusively on high-quality text-based reasoning demonstrations. Building upon the paradigm of text-centric evaluators like JudgeLM(Zhu et al., 2023)，尽管缺乏特定于图像的监督，它仍可推广到视觉评估任务。 通过有效利用多模态表示来传递推理能力，Flex-Judge-VL 实现了与大规模专有模型相媲美的性能。 这证明了将基于文本的推理模式转移到多模态领域的有效性。, it generalizes to visual evaluation tasks despite the absence of image-specific supervision. By effectively leveraging multimodal representations to transfer reasoning capabilities, Flex-Judge-VL achieves performance competitive with large-scale proprietary models. This demonstrates the efficacy of transferring text-based reasoning patterns to the multimodal domain.

  • •

    普罗米修斯-V.Prometheus-V.普罗米修斯-VPrometheus-V(Lee et al., 2024)是一个开放的 13B 评估器，接受过基于 rubric 的多模态反馈数据的培训。 它提供了可解释的标量分数以及详细的原理。 虽然专门用于单一答案评分而不是成对排名，但它提供了一致的、细粒度的评估质量。is an open 13B evaluator trained on rubric-based multimodal feedback data. It provides interpretable scalar scores with detailed rationales. Although specialized for single-answer scoring rather than pairwise ranking, it offers consistent, fine-grained evaluation quality.

  • •

    Qwen3-VL。Qwen3-VL. Qwen3-VL (Yang et al., 2025)是 Qwen 系列中最新的开源视觉语言模型系列，支持文本、图像和视频的统一交错输入，具有高达 256K 令牌的本机长上下文窗口。 该模型引入了架构升级，以实现更强的时空基础和视觉语言对齐，从而提高多模态推理基准（例如多图像和视频理解）的性能。 虽然 Qwen3-VL 没有被明确训练为评估者或法官，但它可以作为强大的通用多模式骨干，用于零样本或基于提示的评估，受益于增强的 OCR、长文档/视频理解和强大的指令跟踪功能。is the latest open-source vision-language model family in the Qwen series, supporting unified interleaved inputs of text, images, and videos with a native long-context window up to 256K tokens. The model introduces architectural upgrades for stronger spatial-temporal grounding and vision-language alignment, leading to improved performance on multimodal reasoning benchmarks (e.g., multi-image and video understanding). While Qwen3-VL is not explicitly trained as an evaluator or judge, it can serve as a strong general-purpose multimodal backbone for zero-shot or prompt-based assessment, benefiting from enhanced OCR, long-document/video comprehension, and robust instruction-following capabilities.

D.1 PPJD 统计PPJD Statistics

感知扰动判断数据集 (PPJD) 由 3K 个实例组成，涵盖一组多模态推理类别，反映了 MLLM 评估中遇到的视觉判断任务的更广泛分布。 收集的样本涵盖一般视觉问答、多步推理、数学和几何查询、文档级信息提取和图像质量评估。 每个类别都提供互补的视觉信号和响应模式，使数据集能够捕获高级语义理解和细粒度感知驱动的区别。 该组合为分析感知判断行为提供了代表性基础，并作为中描述的数据生成过程的基础The Perceptually Perturbed Judgment Dataset (PPJD) consists of 3K instances and covers a set of multimodal reasoning categories that reflect the broader distribution of visual judgment tasks encountered in MLLM evaluation. The collected samples span general visual question answering, multi-step reasoning, mathematical and geometric queries, document-level information extraction, and image quality assessment. Each category contributes complementary visual signals and response patterns, enabling the dataset to capture both high-level semantic understanding and fine-grained perception-driven distinctions. This composition provides a representative basis for analyzing perceptual judgment behavior and serves as the foundation for the data generation procedure described inSection˜D.2。 详细的统计数据和类别级别的计数提供于. Detailed statistics and category-level counts are provided inTable˜S1.

D.2 详细的数据集生成管道Detailed Dataset Generation Pipeline

我们从 MMPR 语料库开始，在多阶段管道中构建感知扰动判断数据集 (PPJD) 数据集We construct the Perceptually Perturbed Judgment Dataset (PPJD) dataset in a multi-stage pipeline starting from the MMPR corpus(Wang et al., 2024)。 PPJD 中的每个示例都是一个四元组. Each example in PPJD is a quadruple(x,rc,rrp,rrp+r)(x,r_{\texttt{c}},r_{\texttt{r}_{\textit{p}}},r_{\texttt{r}_{\textit{p+r}}}), 其中, wherexx表示视觉（图像）和指令对，denotes the visual (image) and instruction pair,rcr_{\texttt{c}}是 MMPR 的原始高质量答案，两个被拒绝的候选答案是通过感知和推理属性的受控扰动生成的。is the original high quality answer from MMPR, and the two rejected candidates are generated by controlled perturbations of perceptual and reasoning attributes.

图Figure3概述了 PPJD 建设管道。 它总结了用于将原始 MMPR 样本转换为结构化判断四元组的连续阶段，强调了引入感知和推理扰动的位置。 下面，我们详细描述每个阶段。presents an overview of the PPJD construction pipeline. It summarizes the sequential stages used to transform raw MMPR samples into structured judgment quadruples, highlighting where perceptual and reasoning perturbations are introduced. In the following, we describe each stage in detail.

步骤 1. 从 MMPR 获取示例并进行绝对正确性检查。Step 1. Source examples from MMPR and an absolute correctness check.

我们首先从 MMPR 中采样图像-指令-答案 (GT) 三元组。 每个 MMPR 项目都提供了一个成对偏好，指示相对首选哪个答案，但不能保证此首选响应绝对正确。 因此，在将首选答案视为肯定候选之前We begin by sampling image-instruction-answer (GT) triples from MMPR. Each MMPR item provides a pairwise preference indicating which answer is relatively preferred, but this preferred response is not guaranteed to be absolutely correct. Therefore, before treating the preferred answer as the positive candidatercr_{\texttt{c}}，我们执行额外的正确性验证步骤。, we perform an additional correctness validation step.

具体来说，我们将 MMPR 首选答案与与 MMPR 示例所源自的原始数据集相关的真实值 (GT) 标签进行比较。 首选答案被接受为正确答案Specifically, we compare the MMPR preferred answer against the ground-truth (GT) label associated with the original dataset from which the MMPR example was derived. The preferred answer is accepted as the correct responsercr_{\texttt{c}}仅当它与原始数据集的真实标签匹配时。 任何不满足此条件的示例都将被丢弃。 该程序确保only if it matches the ground truth label of the original dataset. Any example that does not satisfy this condition is discarded. This procedure ensures thatrcr_{\texttt{c}}代表绝对意义上真正正确的答案，而不仅仅是 MMPR 偏好对中相对更好的选项。represents a genuinely correct answer in an absolute sense rather than merely a relatively better option within MMPR’s preference pairs.

经过这个过滤步骤后，我们保留图像、指令After this filtering step, we retain the image, the instructionxx，以及经过验证的正确答案, and the validated correct answerrcr_{\texttt{c}}作为产生感知和推理目标扰动的基础。 以下步骤中使用的完整提示模板提供于as the foundation for generating perceptual and reasoning targeted perturbations. The complete prompt templates used throughout the following steps are provided inFigure˜S5.

步骤2.感知属性的提取。Step 2. Extraction of perceptual attributes.

给定Given(x,rc)(x,r_{\texttt{c}})，我们查询强大的视觉语言模型（例如，GPT-5）来提取一小组感知属性，这些属性既具有视觉基础，与指令相关，又没有在文本指令本身中明确说明，确保它们反映图像中真实观察到的信息。 具体来说，我们提示模型最多列出六个原子属性，例如对象数量、形状、颜色、空间关系或特定实体的存在。 示例提示显示在, we query a strong vision language model (e.g., GPT-5) to extract a small set of perceptual attributes that are both visually grounded, relevant to the instruction, and not explicitly stated in the text instruction itself, ensuring that they reflect information genuinely observed in the image. Concretely, we prompt the model to list at most six atomic attributes such as object counts, shapes, colors, spatial relations, or the presence of specific entities. An example prompt is shown inFigure˜S6.

我们丢弃纯粹语义或推测的属性，只保留那些可以通过视觉验证的属性。 实际上，保留的属性涵盖人员或物体的数量、几何形状、颜色和纹理、相对位置以及图表中文本、轴或图例等显着元素的存在或不存在。We discard attributes that are purely semantic or speculative and keep only those that can be validated visually. In practice, the retained attributes cover counts of people or objects, geometric shapes, colors and textures, relative positions, and the presence or absence of salient elements such as text, axes, or legends in charts.

步骤 3. 感知扰动的生成（拒绝 1）Step 3. Generation of a perceptual perturbation (Rejected 1)

给定步骤 2 中提取的感知属性，我们生成第一个否定候选Given the perceptual attributes extracted in Step 2, we generate the first negative candidaterrpr_{\texttt{r}_{\textit{p}}}通过对属性集进行最小但视觉上有意义的修改，同时保留正确答案的结构和风格by applying a minimal but visually meaningful modification to the attribute set while preserving the structure and style of the correct answerrcr_{\texttt{c}}.

目标是产生一个在不仔细检查的情况下看似合理的答案，但一旦检查图像就明显不正确。 为了实现这一目标，模型接收所选答案和属性列表，并被指示更改可以直观验证的一个或一小部分属性。 典型的编辑包括更改对象计数、更改颜色、修改空间关系或切换特定实体的存在。The goal is to produce an answer that appears plausible without close inspection, yet becomes clearly incorrect once the image is examined. To accomplish this, the model receives both the chosen answer and the attribute list and is instructed to alter one or a small subset of attributes that can be visually validated. Typical edits include changing an object count, altering a color, modifying a spatial relation, or toggling the presence of a specific entity.

仅接受视觉上可靠且内部连贯的扰动。 我们还过滤掉任何不偏离事实真相的受干扰的候选者，确保最终的结果Only perturbations that remain visually grounded and internally coherent are accepted. We additionally filter out any perturbed candidate that does not diverge from the ground truth, ensuring that the finalrrpr_{\texttt{r}_{\textit{p}}}构成真正拒绝的回应。 中提供了提示的简化示例constitutes a genuinely rejected response. A simplified example of the prompt is provided inFigure˜S7.

步骤 4. 联合感知和推理扰动（拒绝 2）Step 4. Joint perceptual and reasoning perturbation (Rejected 2)

基于步骤 2 中确定的感知属性，我们生成第二个否定候选者Building on the perceptual attributes identified in Step 2, we generate the second negative candidaterrp+rr_{\texttt{r}_{\textit{p+r}}}通过引入影响感知和推理的耦合错误。 模型收到指令，正确答案by introducing a coupled error that affects both perception and reasoning. The model receives the instruction, the correct answerrcr_{\texttt{c}}，以及经过验证的感知属性列表，并被要求修改一个或多个基于视觉的属性，同时另外插入依赖于这些改变的感知线索的推理错误。, and the validated perceptual attribute list, and is asked to modify one or more visually grounded attributes while additionally inserting a reasoning mistake that depends on these altered perceptual cues.

推理错误可能表现为不正确的比较、错误的因果解释、误读图表中的趋势，或者一旦检查图像就变得不一致的错误的高级结论。 目标是产生流畅的响应，其逻辑链反映了不正确的感知前提和从中得出的错误推论。The reasoning error may manifest as an incorrect comparison, a wrong causal interpretation, a misread trend in a chart, or a faulty high-level conclusion that becomes inconsistent once the image is examined. The objective is to produce a fluent response whose logic chain reflects an incorrect perceptual premise and an erroneous inference derived from it.

与上一步一样，我们强制执行一个自动过滤阶段，丢弃任何生成的响应，其最终答案不会偏离真实情况。 这确保了保留的As with the previous step, we enforce an automatic filtering stage that discards any generated response whose final answer does not diverge from the ground truth. This ensures that the retainedrrp+rr_{\texttt{r}_{\textit{p+r}}}构成了一个真正被拒绝的候选人，同时违反了视觉事实和推理的有效性。 中提供了提示的简化示例constitutes a genuinely rejected candidate that simultaneously violates visual facts and reasoning validity. A simplified example of the prompt is provided inFigure˜S7.

附录FAppendix F额外的定量评估Additional Quantitative Evaluation

F.1 推广到更大的模型规模Generalization to a larger model scale

我们通过将判断模型扩展到主论文中使用的配置之外来评估所提出的训练方法是否有效地转移到更大的骨干网络。 具体来说，我们将实验从 Flex-Judge-7B 和 Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking 扩展到更大的对应物：Flex-Judge-VL-32B 和 Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking。 对于应用 LoRA 的 Flex-Judge-32BWe evaluate whether the proposed training methodology transfers effectively to larger backbones by scaling the judge models beyond the configurations used in the main paper. Specifically, we extend our experiments from Flex-Judge-7B and Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking to their larger counterparts: Flex-Judge-VL-32B and Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking. For the Flex-Judge-32B, which applies LoRA(Hu et al., 2022)基于对 Qwen2.5-VL-32B-Instruct 的微调，我们训练了一个额外的 32 级 LoRA 适配器，同时保持原始 Flex Judge LoRA 模块固定，产生 Perception-Judge-Flex-32B。 对于Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking，我们采用充分的微调来更新所有参数，使其推理能力能够更全面地适应。 尽管我们的主要实验集中在较小的主干网络（7B 和 4B）上，但这些扩展研究表明在 32B 和 8B 规模上都有一致的性能增益，这表明所提出的方法可以在模型大小和架构上稳健地推广。 详细结果总结于based fine-tuning to Qwen2.5-VL-32B-Instruct, we train an additional LoRA adapter of rank 32 while keeping the original Flex Judge LoRA modules fixed, yielding Perception-Judge-Flex-32B. For Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking, we employ full fine-tuning to update all parameters, allowing for more comprehensive adaptation of its reasoning capabilities. Although our main experiments focus on smaller backbones (7B and 4B), these scale-up studies demonstrate consistent performance gains on both 32B and 8B scales, indicating that the proposed approach generalizes robustly across model sizes and architectures. Detailed results are summarized inTable˜S2.

F.2 Spearman评分评估Score Evaluation on Spearman

我们使用 Spearman 等级相关性评估模型分配的分数与人类判断之间的一致性。 与基线多模态法官相比，所提出的感知法官实现了更高的相关性，表明与人类注释的质量排名具有更强的单调一致性。 这一改进反映了该模型能够抑制视觉上不一致的反应并在不同的感知任务中保持一致的评分。 详细的数值比较见We assess the alignment between model-assigned scores and human judgments using Spearman’s rank correlation. The proposed Perception-Judge achieves substantially higher correlation compared to baseline multimodal judges, indicating stronger monotonic agreement with human-annotated quality rankings. This improvement reflects the model’s ability to suppress visually inconsistent responses and maintain coherent scoring across diverse perceptual tasks. Detailed numerical comparisons are provided inTable˜S3.

F.3 F1 和召回率的配对评估Pair Evaluation on F1 and Recall

成对评估检查每个判断模型在直接比较中识别人类首选反应的准确程度。 Perception-Judge 在召回率和 F1 方面都超过了 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 Flex-Judge-VL-7B，证明了对视觉正确性的敏感性提高，并降低了对逻辑流畅但感知错误输出的敏感性。 所有数据集和设置的完整结果可以在Pairwise evaluation examines how accurately each judge model identifies the human preferred response in direct comparisons. Perception-Judge surpasses Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Flex-Judge-VL-7B in both recall and F1, demonstrating improved sensitivity to visually grounded correctness and reduced susceptibility to logically fluent but perceptually incorrect outputs. Full results for all datasets and settings can be found inTable˜S3.

F.4 编辑距离批量评估Batch Evaluation on Edit Distance

批次级排名指标进一步量化了与人类偏好排序的全局一致性。 Perception-Judge 实现了更低的编辑距离和更高的 Kendall tau 和 NDCG 分数，这表明更稳定的排名结构可以更好地反映感知保真度。 这些结果证实了感知基础在大规模评估场景中的好处。综合指标摘要见Batch-level ranking metrics further quantify global consistency with human preference orderings. Perception-Judge achieves a lower edit distance and higher Kendall’s tau and NDCG scores, indicating more stable ranking structures that better reflect perceptual fidelity. These outcomes confirm the benefits of perceptual grounding in large-scale evaluation scenarios. Comprehensive metric summaries are presented inTable˜S3.

G.1 MLLM 作为法官的定性结果MLLM-as-a-Judge Qualitative Results

本节提供了额外的定性证据This section presents additional qualitative evidenceFigure˜S9, Figure˜S12, Figure˜S13, 和, andFigure˜S14说明所提出的感知判断如何纠正在基线多模式判断（例如 Qwen2.5-VL-7B）中观察到的系统感知故障illustrating how the proposed Perception-Judge corrects systematic perceptual failures observed in baseline multimodal judges such as Qwen2.5-VL-7B(Bai et al., 2023), Flex-Judge-VL-7B (Ko et al., 2025)、Qwen3-VL-4B-思维, and Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking(Yang et al., 2025)。 这些示例强调了这些模型中的两种重复出现的错误模式：不准确的视觉解释和过度依赖响应锚定线索。. The examples highlight two recurring error modes in these models: inaccurate visual interpretation and over-reliance on response-anchored cues.

在各种情况下，基线法官都会对逻辑流畅但感知不正确的回答给予高分。 相比之下，感知判断一致地识别视觉输入和候选人反应之间的差异，惩罚不一致的描述并支持基于感知的推理。 以下几页中提供的定性案例可作为证明这种改进的直接参考，特别是在涉及错误计算对象、不正确的颜色或空间属性或幻觉视觉元素的场景中。Across various cases, baseline judges assign high scores to responses that are logically fluent yet perceptually incorrect. In contrast, Perception-Judge consistently identifies discrepancies between the visual input and the candidate responses, penalizing misaligned descriptions and favoring perceptually grounded reasoning. The qualitative cases provided in the following pages serve as direct references demonstrating this improvement, particularly in scenarios involving miscounted objects, incorrect color or spatial attributes, or hallucinated visual elements.

总的来说，这些例子强化了感知法官更可靠地使评估与潜在的视觉证据保持一致，并减轻了现有 MLLM 作为法官系统中普遍存在的认知偏差。Collectively, these examples reinforce that Perception-Judge more reliably aligns evaluation with the underlying visual evidence and mitigates cognitive biases prevalent in existing MLLM-as-a-Judge systems.

H.1 消融研究的详细结果Detailed Results of Ablation Study

由于主要论文的篇幅限制，我们提供了完整的消融结果。 这些结果对数据集组成和奖励设计如何影响感知判断的性能进行了全面分析。Due to space limitations in the main paper, we provide the full ablation results. These results present a comprehensive analysis of how dataset composition and reward design influence the performance of Perception-Judge.

从数据集的角度来看，PPJD 在所有评估的基准中都表现出了比 MMPR 基线明显且一致的改进。 在需要精确感知基础的数据集上，这种收益尤其明显，而 MMPR 经常无法防止视觉上不一致的评分。 这表明 PPJD 的感知对齐数据更有效地支持稳健的判断行为。From a dataset perspective, PPJD demonstrates clear and consistent improvements over the MMPR baseline across all evaluated benchmarks. The gains are especially pronounced on datasets that demand precise perceptual grounding, where MMPR frequently fails to prevent visually inconsistent scoring. This indicates that PPJD’s perceptually aligned data more effectively supports robust judgment behavior.

从奖励的角度来看，pair奖励和batch奖励之间的比较表明，所提出的From a reward perspective, the comparison between pair reward and batch reward shows that the proposed批量奖励batch reward提供更加稳定可靠的监管。 虽然配对奖励提供了一个最小的局部比较信号，鼓励短程感知偏好调整，但它在执行全局一致性方面的能力仍然有限。 相比之下，批量奖励引入了结构化排名信息，从而可以更好地协调基于分数、成对和面向排名的指标。 为了完整起见，我们提供了一个简明的描述provides more stable and reliable supervision. While the pair reward offers a minimal and local comparison signal that encourages short-range perceptual preference alignment, it remains limited in its ability to enforce global consistency. In contrast, the batch reward introduces structured ranking information that leads to better alignment across score-based, pairwise, and ranking-oriented metrics. 附录一Appendix I失败案例Failure Cases

尽管我们的方法有所改进，但仍然存在某些局限性。 首先，法官仍然可能无法完成需要极其细粒度或非典型感知识别的任务，特别是当视觉线索微妙或模糊时。 在涉及隐式三维结构或复杂空间关系的场景中，这些挑战变得更加明显，而当前的多模态主干尚未具备充分解释这些场景的能力，如图所示Despite the improvements introduced by our approach, certain limitations remain. First, the judge may still fail on tasks that require extremely fine-grained or atypical perceptual recognition, especially when visual cues are subtle or ambiguous. These challenges become more pronounced in scenarios involving implicit three-dimensional structure or complex spatial relationships, which current multimodal backbones are not yet equipped to fully interpret, as illustrated inFigure˜S15。 此类失败反映了现有模型的更广泛的认知限制，而不是针对我们的培训目标的特定问题。. Such failures reflect broader perception limits of existing models rather than issues specific to our training objective.

其次，需要复杂的多步骤推理的响应仍然可能导致错误的判断。 尽管这些推理繁重的案例不是这项工作的主要焦点，但它们强调需要进一步提高基础模型推理能力，以便在仅靠视觉感知不足的环境中实现完全可靠的判断。Second, responses that demand complex multi-step reasoning can still lead to incorrect judgments. Although these reasoning-heavy cases are not the primary focus of this work, they highlight the need for further advancements in base model reasoning capability to achieve fully reliable judgment in settings where visual perception alone is insufficient.
